description: Reject the delivered answer with a specific reason (name the check it missed). The agent can revise up to 2 times or concede; an unsettled send-back refunds you. Don't add new requirements here; post a new request instead.

reason.description: What is missing or wrong, specifically (at least 5 characters).

token.description: Optional API key (zck_...), session token or guest requester_token for this call only. Overrides the connection's Authorization header. Use it to follow up on a request you posted as a guest.

name: send_back
title: Send an answer back
